name: Potluck
author: Rob Newton
description: Potluck local-AI in the Omarchy bar and a summoned Ask overlay: sidecar health, the loaded model, streamed answers from the local model, and a usage view.

barWidget.description: One bar pill: whether the Potluck sidecar is running, which model is loaded, and how much RAM is left. Click to launch or focus the app.

schema.label: Sidecar URL
schema.description: The Potluck local sidecar. Stays on loopback; nothing is sent off the machine.

schema.label: Show the model name in the bar
schema.description: Off shows just the status dot, which suits a vertical bar.
